hero.title: Albion Online Farming Guide
hero.description: Master the art of resource gathering across all tiers. From beginner zones to the most dangerous T8 Outlands, discover the best farming spots and strategies.

guides.title: Player Progression Guide
guides.description: Step-by-step path from your first hour to end-game farming. Choose the phase that matches your current progress.

beginner.title: Beginner (Pemula)
beginner.goal: Learn the controls, level up your Destiny Board, and gather T2–T4 resources in safe Royal Continent zones.
activities: Complete the tutorial and starter quests
Gather and craft in Blue Zones around your starter city
Unlock the Royal Continent by reaching T3 Adventurer
Try Yellow Zone solo dungeons for early fame
Set Learning Points (LP) on your chosen gathering branch
equipment: T2–T3 Gathering Tools (Axe / Pickaxe / Sickle / Skinning Knife / Stone Hammer)
Pork Pie food buff for +carry weight
tips: Do NOT buy Premium until you understand the game loop
Stick to Blue/Yellow zones — no full-loss in Blue
Spend LP on a single gathering line to fast-track to T6 quickly
Buy a Backpack of Insight for daily silver
Use the in-game map to find resource icons (axe = wood, etc.)

midgame.title: Mid Game
midgame.goal: Specialize one gathering line to T6, enter Red Zones and shallow Black Zones, and start trading on the market.
activities: Farm Red Zone resources (lower competition than Black)
Run group Hellgates 2v2 / 5v5 for silver and loot
Join a small guild and travel together to T6 Black Zones
Use Mists / Avalonian Roads for solo gathering with quick escapes
Refine your own resources for higher market profit
equipment: Stalker Hood (invisibility) or Cleric Cowl (cleanse) for escape
Resurrection Mage Potion + Sticky Potion for survival
tips: Focus ONE resource to T6 before branching out — specialization > generalization
Always carry escape gear in a second slot
Sell raw resources at the city closest to that biome (highest demand)
Avoid 13:00–15:00 UTC peak PvP — go solo at night instead
Check the Killboard before entering an unfamiliar Black Zone

endgame.title: End Game
endgame.goal: Farm T7–T8 resources in deep Black Zone for maximum profit, contribute to guild wars, and master the meta.
activities: Group gathering in Watchtower / Mists / Avalonian Roads
Participate in ZvZ, Crystal League, or Mist Hunting
Craft T8 resources into masterpiece items for huge profit
Run premium content (Castles, Mists Bosses, Avalonian Dungeons)
equipment: Full T8 gathering set with .3 / .4 enchant (when affordable)
Specter Hood (group invisibility) for team gathering
Saddled Eagle or Spectral Bonehorse for travel
Major Healing Potion + Resurrection Mage Potion
tips: Avoid solo gathering during 13:00–15:00 UTC — extreme ganker density
Run with guild or trusted group for Watchtower territory T8
Use scout/spotter alts on the world map for early gank warning
Refine T8 with focus for huge ROI — never sell raw if you can refine
Always have a transport plan back to city (mount + escape gear)

professions.title: Gathering Professions
professions.description: Pick a gathering profession from the Destiny Board. Each one has its preferred biome, tools, and best T8 hunting grounds.

overview.title: Gatherer Overview
overview.description: Gatherers form the backbone of Albion's economy. Every weapon, armor, and consumable starts from raw materials. Pick a path on the Destiny Board, level its tools, and choose your biome wisely.
points: Specialize ONE branch to T6 before opening a second
Bonus yield per tier from the Destiny Board (e.g. +X% items)
Higher tier tools = faster cluster clearing time
Always match biome to resource for maximum yield
T5+ enchanted resources sell for 5–20× the raw tier

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack (Penebang Kayu)
lumberjack.tagline: Chop wood from forests, swamps, and highlands.
tips: Best paired with Forest biome (Lymhurst hub)
Use Stalker Hood for safe ganker escape
Logs are heaviest of all resources — bring Pork Pie
Refining your own planks at Lymhurst gets the city-specialty bonus

oreMiner.name: Ore Miner (Penambang)
oreMiner.tagline: Mine ore from mountains and highlands.
tips: Fort Sterling is the ore refining hub (city bonus)
T8 Meteorite Ore has the highest raw silver value
Pair with Tank build (Knight set) — ore zones get crowded
Use Cleric Robe to cleanse focus drain debuffs

skinner.name: Skinner (Penguliti)
skinner.tagline: Skin hide from animals in steppe, forest, and highland biomes.
tips: Bridgewatch refines hide with city bonus
Skinning animals counts toward Killing Track too — fame double-dip
T8 Direwolf Hide is end-game material for tank armor
Travel light — hide is mid-weight, allows more inventory

stoneQuarrier.name: Stone Quarrier (Pemecah Batu)
stoneQuarrier.tagline: Quarry stone from highlands and mountains.
tips: Martlock refines stone with city bonus
Stone has the lowest PvP competition — great for beginners
T8 Adamantium Stone is required for highest-tier crafting buildings
Stone is heavy — Pork Pie + extra Bag tier is essential

fiberHarvester.name: Fiber Harvester (Pemanen Serat)
fiberHarvester.tagline: Harvest fiber from swamps and steppes.
tips: Thetford is the cloth refining hub
T8 Ghoul Yarrow used for end-game cloth armor (Robe of Purity, etc.)
Fiber is lightweight — bring more bags for max load
Pair with Cleric set to cleanse mob roots in swamps

fisherman.name: Fisherman (Pemancing)
fisherman.tagline: Fish in lakes, ponds, and rivers across all biomes.
fisherman.hub: Any city with water (Caerleon has best market)
bestSpots: Yellow / Red zone lakes (better fish + treasure)
Black Zone deep lakes (T7–T8 rare fish + Hooked Box loot)
tips: Fishing rod is a 1-handed weapon — pair with Bag for capacity
Use Bait (crafted from fish) for higher tier catches
Fishing Spots refresh — move around, don't camp one spot
Excellent solo profession with low ganker risk
Caerleon Black Market sells rare fish for huge silver

builds.title: Recommended Gathering Builds
builds.description: Optimize your equipment for maximum efficiency and safety while gathering T8 resources.

biomes.title: Biome Distribution
biomes.description: Each city specializes in different resources. Choose your farming location based on what you need.

biome_descriptions.swamp: Mystical wetlands with abundant fiber resources and hidden dangers in the mist.
biome_descriptions.forest: Ancient woodlands filled with towering trees and rich wood resources.
biome_descriptions.mountain: Majestic peaks with glowing ore deposits and treacherous terrain.
biome_descriptions.highland: Rocky plateaus with plentiful stone and valuable mineral deposits.
biome_descriptions.steppe: Vast plains where hunters gather hides and fiber under the setting sun.

Red zones offer better resource yields but higher risk
Always use Pork Pie to increase carry capacity
Consider gathering gear for yield bonuses
Use Invisibility Shrines for safe travel to deeper zones
Farm during off-peak hours to avoid gankers
Always plan an escape route
Consider farming in Gold Mists for solo players
Use Roads of Avalon for group farming
High competition - timing is key
Watchtower territories are the best T8 sources

t8Maps.title: T8 Farming Locations
t8Maps.description: Specific map names for each resource type in the Outlands (Black Zone). These are the most valuable farming spots.

events.title: Asia Server Events & Schedule
events.description: Important events and timings for Asia server farming activities.
events.worldBossDesc: World Bosses spawn every even-numbered hour (00:00, 02:00, 04:00, etc.) on Asia server to avoid maintenance collision.
events.worldBossNote: High risk, high reward farming opportunity
events.primeTimeDesc: Peak activity period for PvP and guild activities. Extreme danger in black zones.
events.primeTimeNote: Best time for group farming with guild protection
events.dangerWindowDesc: Highest concentration of gankers and PvP players. Avoid solo gathering in black zones.
events.dangerWindowNote: Stick to blue/yellow zones or farm with group
events.lowActivityDesc: Safest time for solo farming with reduced competition and ganking risk.
events.lowActivityNote: Best for new players and solo farmers

efficiency.title: Efficiency Tips
tips: Use Pork Pie to increase carry capacity
Gather in biomes matching your resource type
Focus on one resource to T8 for max profit
Use Learning Points to speed up leveling
efficiency.radiantTip: 💡 Tip: Use the new Loot All button from Radiant Wilds for faster PvE farming!

safety.title: Safety Strategies
tips: Use Invisibility Shrines for safe travel
Farm during off-peak server hours
Always have escape gear ready
Travel with guild members when possible

profitability.title: Resource Profitability
tips: Stone: Low competition, stable profit
Fishing: Steady profit, requires patience
Ore: Medium competition, good returns
Hide & Fiber: High competition, varied profit
